Frequency once per encounter

Trigger A firearm you are wielding is destroyed, Jammed for the scene, or reduced to unusable.

It works one more time. Make a ranged Strike with the weapon at a +2 circumstance bonus, dealing two additional damage dice. After the Strike resolves, the weapon is destroyed beyond any repair, including by The Workshop in Your Pockets, and including a Good Gun if you chose to do this to one.
